_comment: Measured decode rates for the section 44 workload matrix, on the pinned model and runtime. eval/traffic_budget.py --matrix turns these into the highest weighted gain any submission could physically earn. Every rate here is a BASELINE (control-arm) measurement from results/rtx5090-real.json; none is estimated. An arm with no measured rate is left out rather than guessed, and the tool reports which.
_persisting_l2_bytes_note: persisting_l2_max_bytes as queried from the device by tools/info.cpp (recur_local_info) on this box: 60 MiB of a 96 MiB L2. Adds the persist-family ceiling, which is far tighter than the traffic ceiling.

batch1.source: results/rtx5090-real.json batch1 control; single-sequence decode keeps the fp32 matrix state

concurrency4.source: results/rtx5090-real.json per_concurrency.concurrency4.baseline_runs, mean of 3; packed decode compacts the state to bf16

concurrency16.source: results/rtx5090-real.json per_concurrency.concurrency16.baseline_runs, mean of 3; packed decode compacts the state to bf16
